variables.definition: other comprehensive income per common share
variables.context: Same security, currency, nominal/real basis, timing and period frequency as other quantities in this relationship
Same security, currency, nominal/real basis, timing and period frequency as other quantities in this relationship

assumptions: EPS and OCI per share use identical share denominators, entity, period, ownership attribution and currency.
Comprehensive income is the sum of profit and other comprehensive income.
limitations: This is an analytical per-share measure; it is not necessarily a required reported EPS measure.
Noncontrolling interests and preferred claims must be consistently allocated before forming per-share quantities.
